scope: Retrospective reanalysis of previously inspected Granomaly captures; no attack execution or replay
primary_availability: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: initial coverage audit found zero producer-candidate data-access requests on training-known edges in both targets
normal_split: Existing chronological packet split 60/20/20 with 32-packet embargo; normal-only training prefix fits all banks and scales
history: Observed-caller operation histories, not authenticated UE sessions; normal, source, calibration, target and normal holdout reset separately. Test events update history after scoring without labels; counts remain frozen.
additional_control: Decision tree depth 4, min_samples_leaf 20, balanced classes, trained on the same labelled source data; this is a simple learned-rule model, not a manual policy
thresholds: Normal-only calibration quantile higher; strict greater-than. Hard empirical policies also reported at fixed 0.5. Freeze all thresholds before scoring target and holdout.
selection: No winner chosen on test data. Show every model/input/seed/alpha, each fold separately; gain >=20 percentage points is a prespecified exploratory criterion, not a required outcome.
budget: Eligibility requires both holdout and mixed-target normal observed FPR <= selected alpha. No retuning when this constraint fails.
limitations: The captures and labels have been examined previously; this is not independent confirmation
Only two attack captures; initialization seeds are not independent attacks and no population confidence intervals are claimed
No trusted caller roles, authorization outcomes, tokens, complete UE session keys or joint CU/witness evidence
Operation history rules are empirical caller-history checks, not a complete 3GPP procedure state machine
Primary selected attack condition has zero examples; do not substitute an easier secondary result for it
Counts are request hops, not independent malicious campaigns or proven data disclosure
False marks per hour use only the clean holdout request time span and may not represent operational notification rates
